title: Paul urges forgiveness for the one who was corrected
description: Paul asks the church in Corinth to forgive and comfort the one who received correction from the majority, so that he is not overwhelmed by sorrow and Satan does not gain an advantage. He confirms his own forgiveness and emphasizes that this is a test of their obedience and love [ref:2 Cor 2:5-11|2 Corinthians 2:5-11].
